use_deprecated_decorator: use the deprecated decorator to mark a function as deprecated with a reason string
emit_deprecated_warning: emit a colored deprecation warning message using the deprecated_msg helper function
wrap_function_with_deprecation: wrap an existing function with the deprecated decorator to log warnings on each call
review_deprecated_usage: review code that uses the deprecated decorator to identify functions scheduled for removal
refactor_deprecated_functions: refactor deprecated functions marked with the deprecated decorator to use new replacement APIs
